using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Data;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForStringMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act - Trigger the specific factory lambda on line ~123
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "test-vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "test-embedding",
            serviceId: "test-textsearch");

        // Assert - ServiceProvider.GetService was called (indirectly verified by successful registration)
        using var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = sp.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("test-textsearch");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForResultMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchResultMapper>(new MockResultMapper());
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "test-vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "test-embedding",
            serviceId: "test-textsearch");

        // Assert
        using var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = sp.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("test-textsearch");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "test-vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "test-embedding",
            serviceId: "test-textsearch");

        // Assert
        using var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = sp.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("test-textsearch");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_ThrowsWhenVectorSearchMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
        {
            using var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var factory = () => Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensions
                .AddVectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>(services, "missing-vector", "missing-embedding")
                .BuildServiceProvider()
                .GetKeyedService<VectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>>("test");
        });
        Assert.Contains("No IVectorizedSearch", ex.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_ThrowsWhenEmbeddingGenerationMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<DummyRecord>>(new MockVectorSearchable());

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
        {
            using var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var factory = () => Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensions
                .AddVectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>(services, "test-vector", "missing-embedding")
                .BuildServiceProvider()
                .GetKeyedService<VectorStoreTextSearch<DummyRecord>>("test");
        });
        Assert.Contains("No ITextEmbeddingGenerationService", ex.Message);
    }

    private class DummyRecord { }

    private class MockStringMapper : ITextSearchStringMapper
    {
        public string MapToString(object record) => record.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private class MockResultMapper : ITextSearchResultMapper
    {
        public TextSearchResult MapToTextSearchResult(object record, float relevanceScore) => 
            new() { Text = record.ToString() ?? string.Empty, Relevance = relevanceScore };
    }

    private class MockVectorSearchable : IVectorSearchable<DummyRecord>
    {
        public IVectorStoreRecordCollection<DummyRecord> AsVectorStoreRecordCollection() => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}
